description:
Partner with Edith & George To Promote Award-Winning Organic Baby Gifts & Earn 10% Commission.


Join the Edith & George Affiliate Program and share the love of luxury, organic baby gifts!


Are you a blogger, influencer, content creator, or website owner passionate about high-quality, sustainable, and beautifully designed baby products?

Do you have an engaged audience of parents, grandparents, and gift-givers?

If so, we invite you to partner with Edith & George, a leading UK brand specializing in organic baby gifts and innovative baby monitors.


About Edith & George:

Edith & George is an independent UK business dedicated to providing parents and gift-givers with exquisite, ethically sourced, and beautifully presented baby products. We believe in the importance of natural, organic materials and sustainable practices. Our curated collection is almost exclusively manufactured by us under our own brands and includes:


Award-Winning Organic Baby Gift Boxes & Hampers:

Our signature gift boxes are filled with 100% certified organic cotton essentials, natural skincare, and adorable keepsakes. They were recently awarded Platinum in the Best Baby Keepsake category at the Loved By Parents Awards 2025, as well as being shortlisted in multiple other categories.



The Lullaby Bay LB603 Advance Baby Monitor:

This innovative, no-Wi-Fi baby monitor offers exceptional peace of mind with its enhanced security, long-range signal, crystal-clear video, and advanced features. Also shortlisted in the Loved By Parents Awards 2025.

Why Partner with Edith & George?

  • High-Quality, In-Demand Products: Promote products that parents love and are actively searching for. Our organic cotton, sustainable practices, and beautiful presentation make our gifts stand out.
  • Generous Commission: Earn a 10% commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link.
  • 30-Day Cookie Duration: You'll receive credit for sales made within 30 days of a customer clicking your link.
  • Dedicated Support: We're committed to supporting our affiliates. We provide you with the resources you need to succeed, including high-quality images, banners, and product information.
  • Free Sample Products: Available on request to affilliates with a great fit and established audience.
  • Growing Brand: Be part of a growing UK brand with a strong reputation for quality and customer service.
  • Amazing Customer Service: We're really proud of our small customer service team, (they're all mums and dads too!) and our reviews speak for themselves.


Ideal Affiliate Partners:

We're looking for partners who:

  • Have a genuine passion for baby products, parenting, or sustainable living.
  • Maintain a high-quality website, blog, or social media presence.
  • Engage authentically with their audience.Are committed to promoting ethical and sustainable brands.
  • Focus their content and audience, primarily in the UK.


Commission Structure:

  • 10% commission on all referred sales.
  • 30-day cookie duration.


Get Started Today!

Ready to join the Edith & George family and start earning?

We look forward to partnering with you!
